notes:
{月|つき} has two meanings: the moon (celestial body) and month (time period).

PRONUNCIATION:
- つき: standalone word (moon, month)
- がつ/げつ: in compounds for months

MOON PHASES:
- ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧: full moon
- ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧: new moon
- ⟦{三日月|みかづき}→三日月：17597_mikazuki⟧: crescent moon
- ⟦{半月|はんげつ}→半月：08507_hangetsu⟧: half moon

MONTH EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧: this month
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧: every month
- ⟦{一|ひと}→一：00705_ichi⟧{月|つき}: one month (duration)

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧ (moon viewing) is a traditional autumn activity. ⟦{十五夜|じゅうごや}→十五夜：24745_juugoya⟧ refers to the harvest moon viewing festival.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{月|つき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{綺麗|きれい}→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ - "The moon is beautiful" (famously associated with expressing love indirectly).
